```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(Repeatr)
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)

result <- recap(mygid = params$gid)
ctx <- result$context
```

## `r ctx$where_played` — `r ctx$datestring`

[`r ctx$gid`](`r ctx$url`)

```{r summary-text-1, results='asis'}
cat(ctx$paragraph1)
```

```{r summary-text-2, results='asis'}
if (ctx$has_recording) {
  cat(ctx$paragraph2)
} else {
  cat("No recording of this show is currently available.")
}
```

```{r summary-text-3, results='asis'}
if (ctx$paragraph3!="") {
  notes_doc <- xml2::read_html(paste0("<div>", ctx$paragraph3, "</div>"))
  notes_items <- rvest::html_text2(rvest::html_elements(notes_doc, "li"))
  cat("**Notes:**\n\n")
  cat(paste0("- ", notes_items, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
}
```

```{r map, out.width="90%", screenshot.opts=list(vwidth=700, vheight=500)}
df <- shows_data %>% filter(gid == ctx$gid)
marker_radius <- sqrt(ifelse(is.na(df$attendance), median(shows_data$attendance, na.rm = TRUE), df$attendance) / pi)

leaflet(data = df, options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = FALSE)) %>%
  setView(lng = df$longitude, lat = df$latitude, zoom = 16) %>%
  addProviderTiles("OpenStreetMap.Mapnik") %>%
  addScaleBar() %>%
  addCircles(
    data = df,
    radius = marker_radius,
    color = "#c94040",
    fillColor = "#c94040",
    fillOpacity = 0.5,
    popup = paste0(
      "<strong>Date: </strong>", ctx$datestring, "<br>",
      "<strong>Venue: </strong>", ctx$venue, "<br>",
      "<strong>City: </strong>", ctx$city, "<br>",
      "<strong>Country: </strong>", ctx$country
    )
  )
```
